programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: West Ham have won both of their last two Premier League games and are looking to win three in a row in the competition for the first time since December 2023.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Newcastle haven’t scored in any of their last four Premier League matches without Alexander Isak featuring (D2 L2), having 47 shots and accumulating an xG of 5.57 without scoring in these games.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United (D1 L2), though they failed to win either game (D1 L1) last season for the first time since 2020-21.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Arsenal have won five of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham (D1), including the last three in a row. It’s their longest winning run against Spurs since a five game stretch between January 1987 and January 1989.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Chelsea have won five of their last seven Premier League meetings with West Ham United (D1 L1), and overall have 32 wins in the competition against the Hammers, only beating Spurs more often (37).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.desc: Wildlife conservationist and biologist Forrest Galante faces pirates, jungles, snakes, crocodiles and more as he travels to the coral reefs of the Solomon Islands and Papua New Guinea investigating rumors of a new species of walking shark.

programme.title: Monster Of Oz
programme.desc: In southwestern Australia, an unknown predator with a taste for great white and mako sharks ignites fears of sea monsters in the abyss; filmmakers Dave and Jennene Riggs join Dr. Tristan Guttridge and Rosie Moore to track down the killer.

programme.title: Florida Shark: Blood in the Water
programme.desc: Paul de Gelder is diving into the shark attack "capital of the world" to conduct experiments that could confirm what makes these waters so dangerous and determine methods to mitigate the risk.

programme.title: House of Sharks
programme.desc: In New Zealand's waters, great white "houses" battle for dominance; experts risk it all to reveal the bloodlines that determine their allegiances.

programme.title: Air Jaws: The Hunted
programme.desc: In 2017, five full-grown great white sharks wash up dead on beaches in South Africa; biologist Alison Towner searches for orcas, the possible culprits in this grisly crime, in an effort to find out how great white sharks are being wiped out.

programme.title: Bull Shark Dinner Bell
programme.desc: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Mega Croc
programme.desc: Using data gathered in new experiments, Tristan Guttridge, Rosie Moore and Dr. Sora Kim construct a CGI fight to the death between two of the apex predators in the water, the great white shark and Nile crocodile.

programme.title: Biggest Mako on Earth
programme.desc: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow; a team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world.

programme.title: Jurassic Sharks
programme.desc: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate the superpredators that ruled the seas. Global expeditions yield new evidence of the strangest sharks to ever roam the ocean, and groundbreaking CGI technology brings them back to life.

programme.title: Jaws vs. Orca
programme.desc: Great white sharks are under siege by orcas; experts push into dangerous waters off the coast of Spain, provoking attacks on their boats to reveal how killer whales dominate their deadliest rival.

programme.title: Chum Island: Catching a Killer
programme.desc: Floating on a raft of chum, Dr. Riley Elliott comes eye-to-eye with massive great whites while on a mission to lure and tag the culprit of a brutal shark attack spree that wrecked a tight-knit community in Australia.

programme.title: Invasion of the Mega Sharks
programme.desc: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white believed to be one of the largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

programme.title: Mothersharker: Hammer Time

programme.title: Great White North
programme.desc: There's a growing population of aggressive white sharks in an unlikely location, Canada; Andy Casagrande heads out on an expedition along Nova Scotia's coast to determine if this new population could be the largest in the world.

programme.title: How to Survive a Shark Attack
programme.desc: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder attempts to get attacked by a shark again; under the supervision of experts, Paul provokes sharks to attack him in multiple scenarios, where they bite and tear off prosthetic limbs to teach life-saving tactics.

programme.title: Legend of Deep Blue
programme.desc: Shark experts head to Guadalupe Island to search for Deep Blue; she is believed to be the largest great white measuring nearly 22 feet and weighing more than two tons; if they find her, they hope to shed light on the mysteries of mega sharks.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown

programme.title: Great White Danger Zone
